toolTrace.resultSummary: Detected a pnpm monorepo with a service subdirectory.
Found Node 16 references in package.json, Docker, and GitHub Actions.
Flagged one native addon package for extra validation.
Preferred a staged path because runtime and CI updates can ship first.

issues.title: Native addon dependency needs target validation
issues.issue: The service depends on a native addon package that may not support Node 20 without an updated release.
issues.incompatibilityReason: Native addon packages often require rebuilt binaries or source compatibility verification during major Node upgrades.
issues.defaultTechnicalRecommendation: Upgrade the package to a Node 20 compatible release before taking the final runtime cutover.

alternativeSolutions.title: Stage through Node 18 first
alternativeSolutions.summary: Reduce simultaneous churn while validating native addon support.
alternativeSolutions.rationale: A staged rollout lets the team isolate runtime and dependency changes.

validationSteps.title: Rebuild native addon on Node 20
validationSteps.expectedResult: Install and test commands complete without binary rebuild failures.

bobDecision.summary: Take a staged path: align runtime declarations and CI on Node 18 first, then move the service to Node 20 after the native addon package is validated.
bobDecision.rationale: The repo shows coordinated runtime references across package.json, Docker, and GitHub Actions, so a staged path lowers rollout risk while preserving forward momentum.
prioritizedRisks: CI drift if GitHub Actions remains on Node 16
chosenSolutions: Validate native addon compatibility before final cutover

bobExecutionPlan.title: Align declarations and CI
actions: Update package.json engines and local version files to Node 18.
Update GitHub Actions setup-node values to match the intermediate target.
Refresh Docker base image tags for the same runtime.
validation: Local install and build remain green

bobExecutionPlan.title: Complete the Node 20 cutover
actions: Upgrade or replace the flagged native addon dependency.
Move runtime declarations from Node 18 to Node 20.
Run full validation and release checks.
validation: Test and build pipeline stays green

validationChecklist.title: Dependency install
validationChecklist.expectedResult: Workspace install succeeds on the selected Node runtime.

validationChecklist.title: CI parity check
validationChecklist.expectedResult: Local results match the updated CI configuration.
